description: This is a test class for the EmployeeDirectoryAPI within the OrangeHRM project, specifically containing unit/integration tests for API endpoints related to the Employee Directory. It tests methods such as fetching one or all employees, and confirms that create, update, delete operations are not implemented, verifying proper exception handling.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryAPITest
classes.description: Test suite for EmployeeDirectoryAPI, ensuring correct behavior for fetching employee data and handling unimplemented methods.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the API method to retrieve a single employee record, using data provider for multiple test cases.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the API method to retrieve all employee records, using data provider for multiple test cases.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create operation is not implemented and throws the correct exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule method for create operation is not implemented.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that the update operation is not implemented and throws the correct exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule method for update operation is not implemented.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete operation is not implemented and throws the correct exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule method for delete operation is not implemented.
